notes.title: 1-Week Update & Roadmap Brief
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Huge thanks for your support and feedback in the first week! 🎉[/p][p]​[b]​Current Status:​[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]​[b]​Stability:​[/b]​ No critical game-breaking bugs found![/p][/*][*][p]​[b]​Bug Fixes:​[/b]​ First patch is out. ​[b]​We'll keep fixing reported issues​[/b]​.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​Future Major Features:​[/b]​
We explored adding ​[b]​Multiplayer/Co-op​[/b]​ and a ​[b]​Level Editor​[/b]​.[/p][p]However:[/p][olist][*][p]They are ​[b]​technically complex​[/b]​.[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]​Current sales can't support hiring the needed programmer(s)​[/b]​.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Therefore:[/p][list][*][p]These features are ​[b]​now on hold​[/b]​.[/p][/*][*][p]We'll monitor ​[b]​sales over the next month​[/b]​.[/p][/*][*][p]If sales don't significantly improve by then, ​[b]​they likely won't be developed​[/b]​.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​Rest Assured:​[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Regardless of major features, ​[b]​bug fixes and minor improvements will continue​[/b]​.[/p][/*][*][p]If major features are unfeasible, active development will conclude. We'll carry the lessons learned into our ​[b]​next game​[/b]​.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your understanding! We're still listening.[/p][p][/p][p]Hua[/p]
